title: Selective Verification in Multi-Agent Orchestration with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28173v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agents can agree because they relied on the same flawed evidence. We use an exact model of nine binary votes to examine when a verifier should intervene. In the main comparison, workers err 20 percent of the time under ordinary conditions, shared failures occur in 10 percent of cases, and the verifier errs 2 percent of the time in either state. When worker error during a shared failure is 80 percent, checking close votes yields 7.93 percent verdict error, compared with 9.06 percent for random checks at the same expected check rate. The ordering reverses at 90 percent worker error during failure. At the matched check rate for that regime, checking close votes yields 9.98 percent error, random checks yield 9.41 percent, and ranking checks by their expected error reduction yields 6.73 percent. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的多智能体编排中的选择性验证
translated_abstract: 智能体之间可能达成一致，是因为它们依赖了相同的有缺陷的证据。我们使用一个九次二元投票的精确模型来研究验证器何时应该介入。在主要对比中，工作智能体在普通条件下的错误率为20%，共享故障发生在10%的情况下，而验证器在两种状态下的错误率均为2%。当共享故障期间的工作错误率为80%时，检查票数接近的投票会产生7.93%的判定错误，而在相同预期检查率下，随机检查会产生9.06%的错误。当故障期间的工作错误率达到90%时，这种排序会发生逆转。在该情形下匹配的检查率上，检查票数接近的投票产生9.98%的错误，随机检查产生9.41%的错误，而按预期错误减少量对检查进行排序则仅产生6.73%的错误。该模型还表明，传递分支投票计数能够保持扁平的多数结构，并减少根节点接收的消息数量。设计指南……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个九次二元投票的精确模型，揭示在多智能体系统存在共享故障时，验证器应优先检查票数接近的投票或按预期错误减少量排序检查，从而在相同检查率下显著降低判定错误。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an exact model of nine binary votes showing that, under shared failures in multi-agent LLM systems, a verifier should selectively check close votes or rank checks by expected error reduction to substantially cut verdict errors at the same check rate.
